alfred_facing_boundary: Alfred can request modeled operations, but Steward approval is required for authority-gated execution and Alfred cannot approve his own request.
api_behavior_added_or_changed: POST /ai-services/services/{service_id}/start accepts dry_run and approved_by query semantics
POST /ai-services/services/{service_id}/stop accepts dry_run and approved_by query semantics
POST /ai-services/services/{service_id}/models/load accepts model, dry_run, and approved_by query semantics
approval_workflow_design: runtime/ai_services/approvals.json records requires_approval, approved, and denied decisions; only approved_by=steward can grant approval.
audit_log_behavior: Structured local JSONL records distinguish planned_dry_run, approval_requested, approval_granted, approval_denied, execution_attempted, execution_succeeded, execution_failed, and policy_denied.
dry_run_behavior: dry_run=True returns operation plan, policy decision, command description, approval state, and state path without calling ProcessRunner.
execution_adapter_design: src/estate/ai_services/execution.py adds a mockable ProcessRunner plus execute_plan; real execution is reached only through manifest-declared commands and policy/approval checks.
known_limitations: Real local third-party application launchers remain dependent on operator-provided manifest command templates and local paths.
No desktop GUI approval surface was added; approval is a local runtime artifact/API/CLI semantic.
recommended_next_action: CA review, then add a Steward UI decision surface over runtime/ai_services/approvals.json if desired.
stop_safety_behavior: Stop executes only against a PID already recorded in runtime/ai_services/state.json by the control plane; no arbitrary process matching is performed.
textgen_model_load_behavior: Model names are restricted to safe basename characters and checked against an existing manifest-declared models directory when present; approved real execution starts/restarts via the manifest command template through the runner.
